# Assignment: Hello World (Pint)

A small project for the course using the `pint` library. It calculates speed based on distance and time, converting everything to meters per second.

## Links
* [Notebook on Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/bbbama/hello-world-rse-bartek/blob/main/notebooks/demo.ipynb) - the fastest way to check it out.
* [Documentation](https://bbbama.github.io/hello-world-rse-bartek/) - generated by MkDocs.

## How to run?

1. Install libraries:
   ```bash
   pip install pint
   ```
2. Run tests:
   ```bash
   pip install pytest
   pytest
   ```

## Example usage
```python
from hello_world.core import calculate_speed
print(calculate_speed(10, "km", 1, "hour"))
```
